body:
Raised 2026-10-06 (America/Los_Angeles) by post-merge Auditor `01a10892-0782-7b13-902c-d8b4db6c155d`. Affected PR #1013, merge `c944e017796005726150abef19763db9ffd07154`, head `d4ca3322bda5bf2438788e65df783bdb5a3aaba0`, closed producing issue #996.

Two connected provenance/reproduction defects occur in `data/regional-review/followup-montenegro-422-boundaries-20261005/reproduce.py` and its `comparison.json`:

1. `area_method_source` declares `data/regional-review/regional-review-3c4fe25a21fa428d/source/source/area-assessments.json`. That whole path does not exist at the declared producing baseline `b6cfaada43a1e0472cd833d16733d1fd6065eaec`. The runner actually consumes `data/regional-review/regional-review-3c4fe25a21fa428d/source/area-assessments.json`. Readers cannot resolve the declared evidence link. This is not proof that the consumed area measurements are wrong.
2. Although it verifies nine original baseline hashes through immutable Git, the runner directly consumes current packet area transcriptions/roster/issue/reservation/code without enforcing their complete retained hashes. It then unconditionally overwrites four historical reports. An external manifest containing byte receipts does not enforce those receipts during reproduction.

Actual read-only reproduction: two independent original-script runs (each internally computes twice) reproduced all four historical outputs exactly, with only their destinations and subsequent output reads redirected to exclusive fresh private files. The 30,048-byte comparison SHA256 is `0f26b5da1f7f4e9f68ff8a9e2ff0cdaaf6b0bd15c182f3db63209de1c04ba4f2`. All packet bytes were unchanged.

Executed failure trigger: present one complete-file read-boundary fixture for `source/official-municipal-areas-2017.json`, changing only Plav's transcribed area from 486 to 487 km² and retaining the other fields and all immutable baseline/source geometry. No input file was actually modified. The original script still exits successfully and its positive and negative controls remain byte-identical. Its accepted report now has Plav 487 and table sum 13,970, SHA256 `83c9c8bafcced6d52bccda01a0573d6b0c7ca28549672306bb000338ce119745`. Its two-run control passes for the altered report. Determinism and rejection of an unmatched name do not detect changed retained transcription bytes.

Expected: bind the declared provenance to the exact existing immutable whole-file input; reject changed/wrong-vintage packet, transcription, source, baseline and code bytes before emitting results; write only fresh exclusive versioned outputs. Keep original dated reports and all source bytes immutable.

Bounded additive geography evidence erratum, at most two PRs, exclusively `data/regional-review/montenegro-evidence-996-erratum/`:

- Add a separate guarded runner and erratum for exactly the 23 original native Montenegro subjects. The 23 singleton parents and remaining world features are read-only input contexts. Correct the consumed-area reference in new evidence, retaining both the historical wrong string and original byte receipts.
- Account for the 63 whole original context/packet/scientific-helper pins below, and any added inputs; retain the old 2015-area/2017-geometry and later 2018/current-roster distinctions. Execute two deterministic fresh-output runs and meaningful negative controls for the demonstrated +1 km² drift, wrong source/code/baseline bytes and existing output. Compare new results against immutable originals. Never edit the old script, transcriptions, reports, snapshots or shared helpers.
- Bind actual metrics/control outputs in a versioned manifest and obtain independent exact-head implementation/source review. If a new scientific/geographic conclusion is proposed, obtain its separately applicable review and evidence; mechanical results do not authenticate official facts.

Success: new provenance resolves to the actual pinned area file; changed transcription fails before report generation; all consumed whole inputs have exact immutable pins; exact 23 subject identities and parent context preserved; old bytes remain unchanged; two exclusive deterministic runs and genuine rejection controls retained. Recalculate complete-phase admission with 32 MiB ordinary/decoded object, 256 MiB complete phase and 512 descriptor limits, without chunk/extract/stream bypass.

Readiness: #996 is closed and its canonical claim is released. Complete open/closed issue and open-PR pagination found no existing issue for these defects or owner of the new path. #1159 covers the separate original #422 packet and unavailable source readiness; #1166/#1169/#1170 cover different country/packet defects. Preserve their ownership. This correction uses available retained inputs and does not require retrieving missing official geometry or authenticating official publications. No implementation reservation is taken.

Limits: independently inspected 49,625 unique world IDs across all 36 parts, exactly 23 scoped subjects/parents, and 23 valid retained source geometries. Recomputing source areas with the same pinned scientific helper reproduces all retained six-decimal km² values; it is not an independent mathematical method. Official MONSTAT PDFs, portal/ministry bodies, roster catalog provenance and applicable reuse terms remain unauthenticated under GitHub-only access; no official boundary vector was obtained. The 2015 table mismatch, Plav/Gusinje hypothesis, 2018 roster/water and provisional Tuzi caveats remain. This issue does not resolve geography/source suitability, approve boundaries, authorize imports/deployment or establish publisher acceptance. The original PR audit remains Incomplete.

Complete probe fixture: 1129 bytes, SHA256 `3d58c221701cbc25b3b22a16b9faa95302268884f28d13e3390bad520244f48e`. Complete supplemental phase including all pinned contexts, fixture and two MiB output reserve: 220569047 bytes.
